# Global Energy Atlas

Product key: global-energy-atlas
Canonical product: https://energy-atlas.base44.app/
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/global-energy-atlas/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/global-energy-atlas/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- compare electricity mixes between regions
- learn how an energy system works
- compare energy flows and grid systems
- study historical changes in electricity generation
- show sourced energy data and provenance
- teach me about regional power systems

## Authority

public read-only energy-systems education and evidence exploration

## Boundaries

- educational comparisons are not operational grid instructions
- do not present modeled or historical data as live grid state unless explicitly verified
- source provenance and data limitations should remain visible
- does not provide personalized investment advice
